crm_notes: Summary: Seafoam builds authorization & fraud scoring that must return a decision in <30ms for payment flows; cost matters — they'll evaluate tradeoffs between 7B quantized models vs larger models for edge accuracy.

POC ask: 2-week perf POC. Run Redwood perf harness against their 100k-sample request trace; evaluate batching windows, KV prefix caching for repeated attributes, and int8 vs int4 quant profiles. Provide cost-per-transaction (incl. cache hit scenarios).

Traffic profile (provided): mostly short prompts (~12-60 tokens), bursty during commerce peaks. Typical request JSON ~150B payload earlier but after trimming ~80 bytes; want ~1k-4k qps baseline, spikes to 6k qps.
Targets they stated on call: p95 <12ms for local in-process scoring (current internal), but will accept p99 <30ms for Redwood if cost < $0.0008/decision at scale (monthly ~10M decisions).

Routing/fallback: require smart routing — primary low-latency model in Dedicated pool, fallback to cheaper quantized variant in a different region if capacity constrained. Also want automatic canary rollouts for model swaps.
Security: requires SSO/SAML for console access, per-token audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for EU business lines. Legal asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence.
Decision factors: latency SLOs (top), accuracy/regression risk (top), predictable unit cost (secondary), and observability (token-level breakdowns + per-route histograms).
